examples: 我妈妈在家。
Wǒ māma zài jiā.
My mom is at home.
妈妈今天在厨房给我们做饭。
Māma jīntiān zài chúfáng gěi wǒmen zuòfàn.
Mom is cooking for us in the kitchen today.
我有一个哥哥。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge.
I have an older brother.
我哥哥在医院工作，他是医生。
Wǒ gēge zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, tā shì yīshēng.
My older brother works at a hospital; he's a doctor.
我有一个弟弟。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge dìdi.
I have a younger brother.
我弟弟喜欢和朋友一起踢足球。
Wǒ dìdi xǐhuan hé péngyou yìqǐ tī zúqiú.
My younger brother likes playing soccer with friends.
我有一个姐姐。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge jiějie.
I have an older sister.
我姐姐今天下午要去书店。
Wǒ jiějie jīntiān xiàwǔ yào qù shūdiàn.
My older sister is going to the bookstore this afternoon.
我也有一个妹妹。
Wǒ yě yǒu yí ge mèimei.
I also have a younger sister.
妹妹今年八岁，已经会写汉字了。
Mèimei jīnnián bā suì, yǐjīng huì xiě Hànzì le.
My younger sister is eight and can already write Chinese characters.
这是我爸爸的弟弟，我叫他叔叔。
Zhè shì wǒ bàba de dìdi, wǒ jiào tā shūshu.
This is my father's younger brother; I call him shūshu.
我叔叔是爸爸的弟弟，他住在北京。
Wǒ shūshu shì bàba de dìdi, tā zhù zài Běijīng.
My uncle is my father's younger brother; he lives in Beijing.
伯伯是爸爸的哥哥。
Bóbo shì bàba de gēge.
Bóbo is father's older brother.
我伯伯是爸爸的哥哥，明天来看我们。
Wǒ bóbo shì bàba de gēge, míngtiān lái kàn wǒmen.
My uncle is my father's older brother and is visiting tomorrow.
舅舅是妈妈的哥哥或弟弟。
Jiùjiu shì māma de gēge huò dìdi.
Jiùjiu is mother's older or younger brother.
我舅舅是妈妈的哥哥，他会做饭。
Wǒ jiùjiu shì māma de gēge, tā huì zuòfàn.
My uncle is my mother's older brother; he can cook.
姑姑是爸爸的姐姐或妹妹。
Gūgu shì bàba de jiějie huò mèimei.
Gūgu is father's older or younger sister.
我姑姑是爸爸的姐姐，她喜欢喝茶。
Wǒ gūgu shì bàba de jiějie, tā xǐhuan hē chá.
My aunt is my father's older sister; she likes tea.
阿姨是妈妈的姐妹。
Āyí shì māma de jiěmèi.
Āyí is mother's sister (aunt).
我阿姨是妈妈的妹妹，今天来看我们。
Wǒ āyí shì māma de mèimei, jīntiān lái kàn wǒmen.
My aunt is my mother's younger sister and is visiting today.
我爷爷喜欢喝茶。
Wǒ yéye xǐhuan hē chá.
My paternal grandfather likes tea.
爷爷每天早上去公园散步。
Yéye měi tiān zǎoshang qù gōngyuán sànbù.
Grandpa takes a walk in the park every morning.
我奶奶在家。
Wǒ nǎinai zài jiā.
My paternal grandmother is home.
奶奶今天和我们一起吃晚饭。
Nǎinai jīntiān hé wǒmen yìqǐ chī wǎnfàn.
Grandma is having dinner with us today.
这是我外公。
Zhè shì wǒ wàigōng.
This is my maternal grandfather.
外公是妈妈的爸爸，他住在上海。
Wàigōng shì māma de bàba, tā zhù zài Shànghǎi.
My maternal grandpa is my mother's father; he lives in Shanghai.
这是我外婆。
Zhè shì wǒ wàipó.
This is my maternal grandmother.
外婆是妈妈的妈妈，她喜欢看书。
Wàipó shì māma de māma, tā xǐhuan kàn shū.
My maternal grandma is my mother's mother; she likes reading.
我有一个哥哥。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge.
I have an older brother.
我有一个姐姐，也有一个妹妹。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge jiějie, yě yǒu yí ge mèimei.
I have an older sister and a younger sister.
我也喜欢茶。
Wǒ yě xǐhuan chá.
I also like tea.
我喜欢喝茶，爸爸也喜欢。
Wǒ xǐhuan hē chá, bàba yě xǐhuan.
I like tea, and my dad likes it too.
我有一个杯子。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge bēizi.
I have one cup.
桌子上面有一个红色的杯子。
Zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu yí ge hóngsè de bēizi.
There is a red cup on the table.
他在学校。
Tā zài xuéxiào.
He is at school.
他是我哥哥，今天在学校上课。
Tā shì wǒ gēge, jīntiān zài xuéxiào shàngkè.
He is my older brother, and he's in class today.
她在学校。
Tā zài xuéxiào.
She is at school.
她是我的中文老师，也会说英语。
Tā shì wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī, yě huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
She's my Chinese teacher and also speaks English.
它在桌子下面。
Tā zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn.
It is under the table.
我的猫很小，它喜欢睡在椅子上。
Wǒ de māo hěn xiǎo, tā xǐhuan shuì zài yǐzi shàng.
My cat is small; it likes sleeping on the chair.
